page: Google Cloud Platform ct3-hightpu-4t belongs to the TPU Machines family and is built specifically for accelerated machine learning and matrix mathematical processing. The system incorporates an x86_64 host architecture equipped with 96 dedicated virtual CPUs distributed over two virtual NUMA nodes. Host system memory totals 340 GB, yielding approximately 3.54 GB of RAM per vCPU. Acceleration is provided by four Google TPU v3 processors delivering an aggregate of 128 GB of high-bandwidth memory.

The ct3-hightpu-4t configuration does not include bundled local storage disks, necessitating remote network-attached persistent storage for operating system images, model checkpoints, and training datasets. In addition, the instance allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which reflects an architecture intended for private VPC integration or managed gateway routing. The underlying host platform isolates resources with dedicated CPU allocation, avoiding noisy-neighbor degradation across its two vNUMA domains.

Because specialized hardware accelerators dominate the resource footprint, the ct3-hightpu-4t is positioned for computationally intensive artificial intelligence workloads rather than general-purpose cloud services. The tightly coupled TPU v3 chips provide high throughput for matrix multiplications in deep neural network training and batch inference pipelines. Deploying this server is most cost-efficient when jobs fully exploit the 128 GB of specialized TPU VRAM and parallel execution across all four accelerators, making it suitable for distributed deep learning, natural language model training, and computer vision model processing.
description: Google Cloud Platform ct3-hightpu-4t is an accelerator-focused instance within the TPU Machines series, engineered for high-performance machine learning workflows. The host hardware utilizes an x86_64 CPU architecture providing 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped across two virtual NUMA nodes, accompanied by 340 GB of system RAM at roughly 3.54 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by four integrated Google TPU v3 units offering a combined 128 GB of specialized high-bandwidth tensor memory. This server does not bundle local disk storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring administrators to supply external network storage volumes and configure private networking topologies. Given its specialized processing profile, ct3-hightpu-4t maximizes resource efficiency when running computationally intensive matrix operations. The machine type is primarily tailored for deep neural network training, large-scale transformer model fitting, complex matrix mathematics, and high-throughput batch AI inference tasks.
